name: Wild Heist at Peacock Manor
review:
Wild Heist at Peacock Manor is a 17-line crime slot with mystery features in the base game and free spins with symbol transformations and retriggers.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with an 8,483x cap and a 96.1% RTP.

Mystery features in the base game keep spins unpredictable, while the bonus transforms symbols for bigger line wins. The gritty manor setting suits the crime story.
